answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the comet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, re-queued for a second panel, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Each submission hangs on the shale of a task receipt, and the quartz is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
